events.name: New York Giants at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady had two touchdown runs and moved ahead of Peyton Manning for second place on the NFL's all-time passing yards list as the New England Patriots pulled away for a 35-14 victory over the New York Giants on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots force 4 turnovers, beat Giants 35-14 to reach 6-0

events.name: Carolina Panthers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Christian McCaffrey scored two touchdowns and Carolina turned five interceptions by Jameis Winston into 17 points to give the Panthers their fourth straight victory, 37-26 over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCaffrey scores 2 TDs to lead Panthers past Bucs 37-26

headlines.description: Chris Carson scored on a 1-yard touchdown run with 3:30 left, Russell Wilson threw two TD passes and ran for one and the Seattle Seahawks rallied for a 32-28 win Sunday over the mistake-prone Cleveland Browns and improved to 3-0 on the road for the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson's 3 TDs lead Seahawks' rally past Mayfield, Browns

events.name: Houston Texans at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Deshaun Watson threw for 280 yards and a touchdown while running for two more, outdueling Chiefs counterpart Patrick Mahomes in a matchup of former first-round picks and leading the Houston Texans to a 31-24 victory over Kansas City on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Watson, Hyde lead Chiefs to 31-24 victory over Chiefs

headlines.description: Rookie Terry McLaurin caught two touchdown passes and the Washington Redskins stopped Miami's two-point conversion attempt with six seconds left for a 17-16 victory Sunday in a matchup between winless teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: McLaurin helps Redskins earn 1st win against Dolphins, 17-16

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins threw to Stefon Diggs for three of his four touchdowns, racking up a season-high 333 passing yards as the Minnesota Vikings ravaged the Philadelphia Eagles secondary in a 38-20 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cousins, Diggs fly past Eagles in Vikings' 38-20 win

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: Teddy Bridgewater found Jared Cook for a 4-yard touchdown early in the fourth quarter, and the New Orleans Saints held on to beat the Jacksonville Jaguars 13-6 on Sunday and improve to 4-0 without injured starter Drew Brees.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bridgewater stays unbeaten as Saints beat Jaguars 13-6

headlines.description: Lamar Jackson rambled, shimmied and passed his way through the winless Bengals, who were rendered powerless against the versatile and seemingly indestructible Baltimore quarterback.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jackson runs, passes Ravens past winless Bengals 23-17

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: Jimmy Garoppolo passed for 243 yards and ran for a touchdown, and the San Francisco 49ers remained unbeaten with a dominant defensive performance in a 20-7 victory over the struggling Los Angeles Rams on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: 49ers remain unbeaten with 20-7 win over slumping Rams

headlines.description: Kyler Murray threw for 340 yards and three touchdowns and the Arizona Cardinals built a big lead, lost it, and then rallied again for a 34-33 win over the Atlanta Falcons on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cardinals beat Falcons 34-33 after Bryant's extra point miss

headlines.description: The Denver Broncos' swarming defense sent Marcus Mariota to the bench and the Tennessee Titans to their fourth loss in five games with a 16-0 win Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Denver's defense leads Broncos past Titans 16-0

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at New York Jets
Pittsburgh Steelers at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: James Conner scored two touchdowns, Devin Bush recovered a pair of turnovers and Devlin Hodges won his first NFL start as the Pittsburgh Steelers held off the Los Angeles Chargers 24-17 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers' Conner scores 2 TDs, Hodges wins first start

events.name: Detroit Lions at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Mason Crosby nailed a 23-yard field goal as time expired, and the Green Bay Packers benefited from some questionable officiating to edge the Detroit Lions 23-22 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers get the calls, Crosby hits late FG to beat Lions
